image_description: A dark blue and white minibus parked on a gravel surface. The vehicle features a boxy shape, a large front windshield, side windows, and visible text/branding on the side and front. A portion of another blue vehicle is visible in the bottom right foreground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic compact, high-roof profile of a minibus, distinct from full-size buses.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, and multiple side windows are present along the passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus. The driver's door is visible, and the sliding track for the passenger door is implied by the window configuration.
While the door itself is closed, the panel gaps and window structure indicate a standard sliding side door mechanism typical of this class.
The short hood and grille arrangement confirm a front-engine layout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the camera frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has a two-tone blue and white livery with visible text/logos, fitting the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front wheel matches the size and style of standard commercial van wheels.
The overall dimensions and window count align with the capacity of a minibus.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white text/logo on the side door appears distorted and illegible, resembling AI-generated 'fake text' rather than crisp branding.
The plastic texture of the bumper lacks fine detail and appears slightly smeared or overly smooth compared to the rest of the bodywork.
The blue object in the foreground (likely another car) has warped geometry and unclear boundaries, blending unnaturally into the gravel.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific make/model classification and ensure it falls within the 'minibus' taxonomy despite the unusual livery.
To analyze the illegible text on the side and front for signs of AI generation artifacts (gibberish characters).
To check for edge bleeding between the vehicle and the background, and to verify the structural integrity of the door panels.
To assess the general coherence of lighting and shadows, particularly around the foreground obstruction.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text/logos on the vehicle
Boundary sharpness between the vehicle and the gravel background
Geometric consistency of the foreground object
Texture realism of the front bumper and grille
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the side of the bus. If the image_text_auditor confirms it is gibberish, this is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, evaluate if the foreground object's distortion is due to camera angle or generative failure.
